items.title: Marty Morell interviewed by Monk Rowe, Orlando, Florida, February 24, 2017

ctx.x: Yeah he used to come up – I lived in, you probably know I lived in Canada for about 25 years and he used to come up to do projects up there, and fortunately he always asked for me in the rhythm section, so that was pretty nice. And I did a lot of dates and sessions with Sammy. Sammy is a great writer. Amazing writer.
